prf.about: WebAuthn PRF (CTAP2 hmac-secret) the way Nodkey does it: salt = SHA-256("WebAuthn PRF" || 0x00 || input), output = HMAC-SHA256(cred_random, salt), 32 bytes. cred_random is a fixed test value of the vectors' passkey (credential_id), never a real one. The same passkey and input always give the same output.
prf.label: WebAuthn PRF

webauthn.about: A passkey made and used the way Nodkey does it: ES256, flags UP|UV|BE|BS (0x1d; 0x5d with attested credential data), sign count 0, "none" attestation. The signature is DER over authenticator_data || SHA-256(client_data_json) with RFC 6979 nonces, so it is reproducible; a recipient verifies it with public_key_spki. The private key is a fixed test key, never a real one.
